stem:
Esha places samples on a hard surface and beats them with a hammer. A copper strip flattens into a sheet. A piece of sulfur breaks into pieces. A block of wood neither flattens into a sheet nor breaks into pieces in this test.

Which classification is correct?

options.text: Copper is malleable; sulfur is brittle; wood is neither malleable nor brittle in this comparison.
Copper is neither malleable nor brittle.
Sulfur is malleable because it changes shape when beaten.
Wood is brittle because it is not malleable.

teacher.key_rationale: Flattening on a hard surface shows malleability; breaking into pieces shows brittleness; wood shows neither here. Calling copper neither ignores the hard-surface flattening result; breaking is not malleability; not malleable does not make wood brittle in this activity.
